See the formula ↓

How the calculation works

Adjusted average = Sum of retained grades ÷ Number of retained grades

A worked example

For grades 60%, 80%, 90% and 100%, dropping the lowest one leaves 80%, 90% and 100%. The revised average is 270 ÷ 3 = 90%, compared with 82.5% before the drop.

Before you use the result

Use within one category where all scores are equally weighted. At least one score must remain. Equal lowest scores can be removed in any order because the retained average is identical. A point-based category or a rule protecting certain assessments needs a different calculation.

Results display to two decimal places unless stated otherwise. Read our calculation methodology for scope and limitations.

Frequently asked questions

Can I drop every score?

No. An average needs at least one retained score.

What if assignments have different possible points?

This tool averages percentages equally. It does not select which point-based assignment would maximize your grade.
